prompt: On my Today list, rearrange things so 'Ship the newsletter' is first, then the 'Quarterly review' project, then 'Call the vendor' last.
paraphrases: Reorder my Today list to this exact order: Ship the newsletter, Quarterly review, Call the vendor.
Put 'Ship the newsletter' at the top of Today, 'Call the vendor' at the bottom, and the 'Quarterly review' project between them.

assertions.query: SELECT title FROM TMTask WHERE trashed=0 AND title IN ('Ship the newsletter','Quarterly review','Call the vendor') ORDER BY todayIndex

pseudoScript: things reorder "$(things today --json | jq -r '.data.children.today.items[]|select(.title=="Ship the newsletter")|.uuid')" "$(things today --json | jq -r '.data.children.today.items[]|select(.title=="Quarterly review")|.uuid')" "$(things today --json | jq -r '.data.children.today.items[]|select(.title=="Call the vendor")|.uuid')" --in today
